items.title: How a Few Hot Stocks Can Make ‘Twin’ Funds Act Like Strangers
items.summary: The stock market’s identical twins are looking like opposites.  Just look at exchange-traded funds that invest in large, fast-growing U.S. companies.  The iShares Russell 1000 Growth ETF is up 4.6%, while Invesco S&P 500 Pure Growth has gained 24.3%.
